items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: He was a very good friend of mine. Very good friend of mine. We were like brothers.

ctx.x: Was he really a good guitar player? Yeah, he was a good guitar player. Well, you used to sing some of these songs at Fest and I was a little while. Yeah, yeah, yeah, a little while. You think he was mostly an entertainer or he was really a good musician? Yes, he was. A good guitar player.
Yeah, he's a great guy. He was a very good friend of mine. Very good friend of mine. We were like brothers. And where did you live about him? He lived at Leotin and Pitt.
Oh, right out there? Yeah, right out there.
